title: Facelift | Common Questions Patients Ask About the Procedure

html:
If you look at yourself in the mirror and are concerned about the changes you see in your face, and if you think the best way to regain a more youthful appearance is through a facelift, it may be time for you to become more informed about what exactly this surgery entails and what results you can expect to achieve.

A facelift at Hanemann Plastic Surgery in Baton Rouge is a procedure that reshapes the lower part of the face by removing excess facial skin. It can also tighten underlying tissue, and it is sometimes combined with surgery to enhance cheeks, the forehead, eyebrow area,and eyelids.

What Is It And What Does It Do?

Now that you are seriously considering this option, it may be useful to learn some important aspects of what it is and what it involves. This surgery is usually done as an outpatient procedure. It may require local anesthetics and sedatives or general anesthesia, depending on your case. A facelift:

  • Reduces droopy cheeks around the jawline.
  • Removes and tightens sagging skin.
  • Reduces the creases between cheeks and lips.
  • Lifts the corners of the mouth.

Is It The Same As A Mini Lift?

In the past, facelifts were performed with larger, more invasive incisions. These days, most surgeons refer to this procedure as a mini lift because medical professionals have become smarter and more efficient and effective when performing it.

How Long Does It Last?

The quick answer is forever, but you should consider that time continues to pass, and we continue to age. Think of it as a fresh start since you will look naturally younger than you are right now.

Where Will The Incision Points Be?

The tiny incisions required for this procedure are virtually invisible. You will need to look for them in order to find them hidden at your hairline and inside your ear. However, you might need to use a magnifying glass!

What Is The Recovery Time?

Each patient reacts differently, but in general terms, you can expect your recovery to take about two weeks. Vigorous activity can be resumed after about four weeks. Obviously, following your doctor’s recommendations will make your recovery smoother.

Contact Us

Call the offices of Dr. Michael Hanemann Plastic Surgery in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, here today to schedule an initial consultation for your facelift. Dr. Hanemann and his experienced and caring staff are committed to helping you achieve your personal reconstructive or plastic surgery goals every step of the way.
